question: Will Iraq's oil deal hold, yes or no?
hook_lines: US deal on Hormuz oil route

lines.text: Iraq says the Iran war has cost it sixty billion dollars.
Foreign Minister Fuad Hussein says Iraq has reached an understanding with Washington to export oil through Hormuz.
lines.note: Hussein to Al Jazeera, via Reuters

lines.text: He says Iraqi oil will move through a shipping lane near Oman.
Iraqi officials say exports recovered in October, to about three point five million barrels a day.
That is up from two point six five million in September.
Hussein says the US Treasury asked Iraq to close all but two of its border crossings with Iran.
One of the two would stay open in the Kurdistan Region.
Iraq has already closed some crossings, including Al-Sheeb in the south.
Tehran criticised that, saying Baghdad gave no advance notice.
In the strait, Iran's navy says another oil tanker hit a mine and caught fire on Sunday.
Donald Trump told CNN renewed attacks on Iran are highly unlikely if talks show progress.
Day two hundred and fifty five tomorrow. Will Iraq's oil deal hold, yes or no?
